candidate.rationale: Determinism check did not run and the analyzer flagged no_candidate_postcondition and semantic_disposition:compiler_internal. open_local_invariant_begin is verifier::external and wraps compiler/internal invariant machinery whose representation and predicate names are not visible in the snapshot. Any nontrivial postcondition would need to reference implementation-private invariant internals (or be vacuous). To avoid unsound or meaningless specs, skipping is appropriate.
risks: Declaring a spec that references hidden invariant internals (Predicate fields, keys, or view functions) could be unsound if names/semantics differ from the real implementation.
Providing a vacuous or overly weak ensures would give false assurance while adding little verifiable value.
Assuming observable, deterministic behavior of a compiler-internal verifier hook may be incorrect across compiler/VIR translations.
